Humane Intelligence is a nonprofit organization founded in 2022 and headquartered in Katy, Texas, United States. Its website is humane-intelligence.org. The organization's own site did not provide substantive descriptive text at the time of collection; it returned only a placeholder message reading "One moment, please..."

The available information lists no AI products, no litigation cases, and no MCP servers for the organization. It does include 126 Texas law exposure entries associated with Humane Intelligence. No aliases are listed.
